title: Intellectual Property Act 2011 - Notice of Commencement (S.R. 2012/14)
text:
S.R. 2012/14
SAMOA
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ACT 2011
NOTICE OF COMMENCEMENT
Pursuant to section 1(2) of the INTELLECTUAL
PROPERTY ACT 2011 (the Act), I, FONOTOE
NUAFESILI PIERRE LAUOFO, Minister of Commerce,
Industry and Labour, NOMINATE 1 OCTOBER 2012 to be
the commencement date for the Act.
DATED at APIA this 12th day of September 2012.
signed: (Hon FONOTOE Nuafesili Pierre Lauofo)
MINISTER OF COMMERCE, INDUSTRY
AND LABOUR
__________
Issued under the authority of the Regulations Ordinance 1953.
Date of Commencement: 1 October 2012
Notice: Samoa Observer: 16th September 2012
These Regulations are administered by the Ministry of
Commerce, Industry and Labour.
Copies of these Regulations can be purchased from
the Office of the Clerk of the Legislative Assembly.
Printed by the Clerk of the Legislative Assembly,
by authority of the Legislative Assembly.
